about_the_game:
Seamless Play, Relaxed Gains

"Loot of Baal" is an idle game nestled right on your screen's sidebar. Multitask your way to glory by sending your hirling crew out to explore, fight demons, and collect loot while you focus on other things! With hundreds of uniquely skilled hirlings, over 1000 distinct items, and a wealth of randomized battle stages, there’s always something to discover. Dive into the crafting system for even more depth, and look forward to an online item trading system coming within two months for a fully interactive experience!

Explore Builds, Embrace Creativity

Assemble your hirling crew from 4 distinctive classes, experiment with 72 unique skills, and gear up with over 400 Immortal items and 1000+ unique equipment pieces. Design creative combos to tackle diverse challenges—blast enemies with elemental magic, enchant weapons into mythical artifacts, or stack auras to bolster your team. Create your own unstoppable style!

Loot Galore, Endless Surprises

The loot system is rich with randomness, offering a treasure pool with thousands of different affixes. Each drop is a surprise, combining random traits from this pool to create one-of-a-kind items. From magic to legendary and all the way to epic items, every discovery is a step closer to perfection. And chasing those maxed-out stats? That’s an endless journey in itself!

Craft Freely, Gear Up

Want to craft your own gear? Go wild with over 200 equipment items you can create. Even basic gear can be game-changing—thanks to built-in socket mechanics. Slot runes in the right order, and you’ll upgrade gear to Immortal levels, complete with unique effects. Plus, explore options like upgrading, socketing, unsocketing, and synthesizing for unmatched creative freedom.

Diverse Classes, Strategic Combos

Experience a perfect blend of classic and innovative gameplay! Not only can you recruit 4 iconic classes—Mage, Paladin, Ranger, and Berserker—but the introduction of three-hirlings crews takes strategy to a whole new level. Pick your crew wisely, balancing class traits, skill combos, and tactical demands. Together, tackle challenges, forge your legend, and begin an unforgettable adventure!
